channel.title: Tesseract
channel.description: The AIOS — a client to Celestia.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description: The app icon, and a connection you can see: the toolbar now carries the home server's own state with the real marks of the services behind it, fetched from their domains rather than drawn. Sign-in assembles rather than appears, and Connections reports what home is actually holding.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: Terminals rebuilt on the daemon: one durable tmux session per agent, every terminal visible including ones started from Termius, live state over an event stream instead of polling, and sign-in over Supabase OAuth so a Mac on the tailnet no longer needs pairing approval.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description: Databases tab (Supabase-Studio-shaped table editor), the Saga Pipeline workspace with a live disc-to-Plex timeline, activity narration, a typable terminal for every agent, and a terminal gallery with reconnect instead of dead-end sessions.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description: First shipped release: the AIOS workspace, embedded terminal, approvals queue, on-device SQL, Sparkle auto-updates, and Supabase account sign-in.
